name: Small Tuck End Box
summary: A small reverse tuck end carton, 27.5 x 27.5 x 58 mm inside, with rounded tucks and a 9.5 mm glue flap. Made for lip balms, serums and sample bottles in 300 gsm card.
tip: For boxes this small, keep text and logos at least 3 mm away from every fold so they stay readable after folding.
